Transient: The machinations of Calyx have been thwarted, releasing Alexandria from the throes of chaos. In the midst of this hard-fought respite, Krile reflects on her journey through Tural, and resolves to face a burning question concerning her place of birth. To aid her in seeking out an answer, you accompany her to the surface of the Ninth, where lightning strikes without end, and the heavens rage with deafening peals of thunder...

Hearsay of a curious creature leads you into the thick of the Twelveswood, where you discover not only a mysterious Cu Sith, but practitioners who profess a novel relationship between mankind and beast─one not of conflict, but of trust. Under the tutelage of J'yhuh Tia, you venture into wilds unknown to follow your calling as a beastmaster...
